description: Searchable list of the template variables available to the document. Selecting a variable raises OnInsert with its {{ path }} token, and collection variables are badged so array bindings are recognizable.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: The variables available to insert (extracted from the document plus host-provided).

parameters.name: OnInsert
parameters.description: Raised with the {{ path }} token when a variable is chosen.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the picker read-only: inserting a variable edits the document, so the list is disabled and OnInsert is never called.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The text in the search field, two-way bindable (@bind-Filter). Lets a host keep the filter across a remount such as a desktop/tablet layout flip; null is the empty filter. Without a binding the picker keeps the text itself.

parameters.name: FilterChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new text whenever the user edits the search field.
